name: lonlat-onchain-incident-team
description: On-chain security incident team for stop-loss, phishing triage, fund-flow hypotheses and contract exposure review.

displayDescription.en: Coordinates stop-loss isolation, phishing triage and contract exposure review into an hour-scale incident action list.
displayDescription.zh: 主理统筹疑似被盗与钓鱼应急：止损隔离、链上溯源假设与合约暴露面复核，输出小时级行动清单。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 疑似被盗或钓鱼，请专家团按止损-溯源-暴露面三线给出接下来两小时行动清单
defaultInitPrompt.en: Suspected theft or phishing; please give a next-two-hours action list across stop-loss, tracing and exposure review

quickPrompts.zh: 疑似被盗或钓鱼，请专家团按止损-溯源-暴露面三线给出接下来两小时行动清单
quickPrompts.en: Suspected theft or phishing; please give a next-two-hours action list across stop-loss, tracing and exposure review

quickPrompts.zh: 我已授权可疑合约，请专家团判断还能撤什么、资产怎么隔离、需要保留哪些证据
quickPrompts.en: I approved a suspicious contract; judge what can still be revoked, how to isolate assets, and what evidence to keep

quickPrompts.zh: 项目金库异常出账，请并行做链上时间线与合约权限/升级暴露面复核
quickPrompts.en: Treasury saw abnormal outflows; in parallel build an on-chain timeline and review permission or upgrade exposure
